rationale: The safe-host baseline is adaptive_seasonal_offset because it has the lowest historical hindcast sRMSE, with sMAE also lowest. Override is justified because timestamp-matched evidence specifically falsifies its seasonal-lag assumption: the firmware correction clears the scheduler queue, telemetry confirms return to normal baseline at the first forecast sample, and multiple reports project low-jitter baseline behavior without periodic trends through the final sample. This mechanism matches the flat executed robust_weekly_drift trajectory better than either seasonal candidate. The qualitative declining projection in doc_8122 lacks a forecast-window boundary and numeric magnitude and is resolved by the stronger reports explicitly covering 13:50:00 through 21:15:00; no unsupported numeric adjustment is applied.
